next: **[infra] The Stop hook's run-record cause reads a legitimate WAIT on a dispatched background Workflow or Agent as abandonment (2026-09-23)** — while `/fabrik-spec-review` round 1 waited on its review-loop workflow, `final_gate_stop.py`'s fifth cause blocked the turn three times ("COMMAND STILL RUNNING"). The only in-turn wait that passed was a foreground `until` loop. The kaizen stream holds 1,379 `stop_block cause=run-record outcome=warned_through` events in its 35 days (snapshot `docs/reference/research/2026-09-23-stop-compaction/stop-events-2026-09-23.json`), and some unknown share of them is this. It is the mirror of the premature-stop problem: a false BLOCK, not a false stop. The fix belongs to the run-record cause: treat a same-session background task still running (the Stop input's `background_tasks[]`, E1 of the spec below) as a legitimate wait. Out of scope of `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-23-stop-and-compaction-enforcement-design.md` (its Intake I17). Owner: infra.
